messages:
peter: Quick FYI 1: Found a 404 in architecture/runtime-performance.md - the diagram link points to /assets/diagrams/kv-flow.svg#kv-caching which 404s in staging preview. Looks like the fragment changed. Anyone own this file?
alina: that's under eng-platform docs. I can take a look. Can you paste the exact failing URL from the preview logs?
peter: staging preview error: GET /assets/diagrams/kv-flow.svg#kv-caching -> 404. The image exists but the anchor fragment isn't in the svg (we stripped ids during the svg-optim step).
marc: ah yes, svg optimizer removed id attributes to shave bytes. Two options: re-add the id in the SVG, or change the docs to reference the figure caption anchor instead. I'd prefer adding an explicit fragment id so internal links keep working.
ivy: if we add ids back we should also include a small test to ensure the CI link-checker validates svg fragments. Otherwise it will regress again.
docs-bot: docs-lint:warning 0: broken fragment detected in architecture/runtime-performance.md -> /assets/diagrams/kv-flow.svg#kv-caching
marc: plan: 1) update assets/diagrams/kv-flow.svg to restore element id="kv-caching" 2) add a tiny test in docs/tests/test_svg_fragments.py asserting the fragment exists 3) add doclinks.yaml redirect from the old fragment-less path for safety? (maybe unnecessary if we keep canonical)
alina: I'll add the SVG id + test in a single PR. Branch: docs/fix/kv-svg-frag-5987. I'll ping marc for review.
marc: also add frontmatter `owner: eng-platform` to architecture/runtime-performance.md so future alerts route correctly.
ivy: good. For the test, simple check: open svg file and assert `id="kv-caching"` present. Keeps CI fast.
docs-bot: tip: run `npm run docs:link-check` and `pytest docs/tests/test_svg_fragments.py` locally before pushing.
ci-bot: pro-tip: if the svg is optimized by the build pipeline you might need to update the pre-optimization source or pipeline step.
alina: thanks, noted. I'll update the source svg in docs/assets-src and the pipeline will carry it over. PR coming shortly.
alina: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/1407 - adds id to SVG, test, owner frontmatter, changelog entry.
ci-bot: build/links  job queued for PR 1407
ci-bot: build/links  job passed
marc: quick skimed the PR. One tiny nit: prefer the svg id on the <g> element that contains the cache flow so the fragment jumps reliably. Otherwise LGTM.
alina: updated, squashed, pushed.
marc: Approved.
docs-bot: docs-deploy: staging preview published for PR 1407.
peter: verified on staging - fragment now resolves and the in-page jump works. Thanks team!
ivy: added a short note to the maintainer checklist to avoid removing meaningful ids in future svg-opt runs.
peter: I'll close the customer ticket. :+1:
